newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan car shares rise in afternoon on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan car shares rise in afternoon on weak yen.

text.p: Japanese carmakers' shares were driven higher in the Wednesday afternoon session in Tokyo on buying by pension funds, which were encouraged by a modest weakening of the yen against the dollar, brokers said.

At 0459 GMT, Honda Motor Co Ltd was up 50 yen at 3,900, after briefly touching a new high for the calendar year. Toyota Motor Corp rose 80 yen to 3,410. Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd gained 20 yen to 610 and was the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with turnover of 11.63 million shares.

"The U.S. stock market firmed overnight, which helped make the mood optimistic," a trader at a foreign brokerage said. "Automobile shares had been in a correction lately and were down at an attractive level for pension funds to buy."
